name: PerformanceTestingBatteryTracker
tagline: Fitness testing days, z-scores vs norms, meaningful change and team benchmarks – one drop-in Power Apps control.
description: A complete performance-testing app for clubs, academies, universities and performance centres: schedule testing sessions for a squad, enter CMJ, sprint, agility, Yo-Yo and IMTP results at speed, verify or flag suspicious values, and see every result as a z-score, T-score and percentile against team, reference or your own norms – with a colour-banded benchmark matrix, athlete trends with smallest-worthwhile-change and typical-error rules, and alerts for meaningful declines.
features: Demo mode with a fictional club (16 athletes, 7 tests, 3 sessions, 336 results)
Built-in test library with units, direction, plausible ranges and typical error
z-score, T-score, percentile and five score bands
Norm basis: team, reference or your own norm columns
Meaningful change vs SWC and typical error
Status flow Scheduled → Recorded → Verified with Flag/Retest/Exclude reasons
Athlete × test benchmark heat map with composite z
Trend chart with team mean and SWC band
Fast keyboard result entry per test
Quick filters, filter drawer, sort and group
Phone layout with bottom view bar and athlete cards
